summary: Regression + brand-consistency sweep of the RadioLife -> FUUSIC rebrand across the shared FastAPI backend, /app/frontend (web) and /app/mobile (Expo). Web app compiles clean (frontend supervisor RUNNING, no build errors in logs), all core routes render: `/` (FUUSIC home shell), `/about` (FUUSIC hero + F·U·U·S·I·C grid, both testids about-hero + about-meaning present), `/login`, `/pricing`, `/shop`, `/listen`, `/social` (Together/Live/Moments/Pulse/Friends tabs). Password login POST /api/auth/login with demo@bigfm.dubai / DemoPass123! succeeds, header lockup reads 'FUUSIC · LISTEN · CONNECT · PLAY · SHOP · EARN'. Metadata verified: <title> = 'FUUSIC — Everything You Love, Together.', og:image = /fuusic-og.png (file present), manifest short_name = 'FUUSIC', favicon/OG assets present under /app/frontend/public. Mobile Expo web preview boots cleanly, demo-login-btn tap authenticates via POST /api/auth/demo and the bottom tab shell renders 5 tabs. Backend health OK (uptime 400s+, no import errors, bigfm-backend). NO regressions detected from the mass find/replace (the previously-fixed App.js legacy import path is holding). HOWEVER — a real brand-consistency regression remains: several visible 'RADIOLIFE' strings still ship in principal consumer flows on both web and mobile (Login footer, Pricing hero-eyebrow + billing footer, Radio.js footer on web; mobile Login footer, Shop eyebrow, Play&Win house tag, Dining Club, Profile help email). These are NOT inside design_radiolife/ and are NOT technical identifiers, so they need to be renamed to FUUSIC. Additionally, some backend consumer-visible strings (dream-cluster share image caption 'RADIOLIFE · DREAM MATCH', soft-launch email base URL 'https://radiolife.app', partner contact fallback partner@radiolife.app) still say RadioLife.

action_items: Replace remaining hardcoded 'RADIOLIFE' strings with BRAND.name / BRAND.premiumName / BRAND constants in these mainstream (non-design_radiolife) files: web -> Login.js:330, Pricing.js:143 & 257, Radio.js:923, PlayAndWin.js:210, games/SlotMachine.js:43, Admin.js:514, AdminBulkUpload.jsx:231; mobile -> app/login.tsx:266, app/(tabs)/shop.tsx:106, app/play-and-win.tsx:153, app/dining/index.tsx:63.

Consider a follow-up regex sweep with an explicit allow-list of technical identifiers (bigfm_session, `design_radiolife/` path, radiolife design-variant key, station_type=radiolife, radiolife_wallet Stripe metadata, JWT issuer 'radiolife-ads') so ONLY user-visible strings get changed on subsequent passes.
critical_code_review_comments: The rebrand relies on scoped find/replace but several files still emit hardcoded 'RADIOLIFE' literals rather than reading from `BRAND` (frontend/src/config/brand.js) or `BRAND_NAME` (backend/core/brand.py). Adopting the central brand config in Login.js, Pricing.js, Radio.js, PlayAndWin.js, SlotMachine.js and mobile login/shop/dining/profile would make future rebrands mechanical.

Mobile `origin_url: 'https://radiolife.app'` is repeated in 3 files for Stripe/Share redirects — this should be a single helper reading BRAND.domain so the OAuth/checkout return URL matches the actual domain post-rebrand (otherwise Stripe will happily redirect users to a domain the tenant may not own anymore).

PIL image caption in backend routes/dream_clusters.py hardcodes brand text into a share PNG — every dream share downstream will keep saying RADIOLIFE until this is patched *and* cached images are re-generated.
There is no lint/CI check preventing new hardcoded 'RadioLife' strings. A simple grep guard in a pre-commit hook (with an allow-list for the technical identifiers) would catch drift going forward.

Backend regression tests were not re-run this iteration since no backend code changed; the shared backend surface passed 100% in iter162.
rca of the issue: Root cause: the scoped find/replace targeted the code paths listed in the rebrand PR but missed pockets of literal 'RADIOLIFE' text inside legacy hero-eyebrow / footer components that predate the central BRAND config. Because DISABLE_ESLINT_PLUGIN=true is set in /app/frontend/.env, there is no static check to flag hardcoded brand strings. Mitigation: (a) migrate the enumerated files to import from /app/frontend/src/config/brand.js and /app/mobile/src/config/brand.ts, (b) rename the 4 backend consumer-visible strings, and (c) add a CI grep guard on /RADIO\s*LIFE/i excluding the design_radiolife/ path and a small allow-list of technical identifiers.
